description: Maximum deck joist span from Table 9.23.4.2.-A, the smallest built-up lumber beam from Table 9.23.4.2.-H for your post spacing, and the minimum post size from Article 9.17.4.1. of the 2024 Ontario Building Code. Source: 2024 Ontario Building Code (O. Reg. 163/24), Division B, Tables 9.23.4.2.-A and 9.23.4.2.-H, Articles 9.4.2.3., 9.4.2.2., 9.17.1.1. and 9.17.4.1., and SB-1 Table 2.

city.description: Ontario city, to read the 1-in-50 year ground snow load Ss and rain load Sr from SB-1 Table 2. Leave empty and give ss_kpa and sr_kpa instead.

other_side_span_ft.description: Joist span on the far side of the beam, for a beam in the middle of the deck. Leave 0 for a beam at the edge. Unit: ft.

post_spacing_ft.description: Clear span of the beam between posts, in feet (or use post_spacing_m). Unit: ft.

post_spacing_m.description: Beam span between posts in metres, instead of post_spacing_ft. Unit: m.

size.description: Joist or rafter size (38 mm thick).

spacing_mm.description: Spacing on centre (12, 16 and 24 in are also accepted). Unit: mm.

span_ft.description: Joist clear span in feet (or use span_m). With a ledger on the house this is the distance from the ledger to the beam. Unit: ft.

span_in.description: Extra inches added to span_ft. Unit: in.

span_m.description: Joist clear span between the ledger or beam on each side in metres, instead of span_ft. Unit: m.

sr_kpa.description: Rain load Sr from SB-1 Table 2, used when city is empty. Unit: kPa.

ss_kpa.description: Ground snow load Ss from SB-1 Table 2, used when city is empty. Unit: kPa.

name: deck_joist_and_beam_span_calculator
title: Deck Joist and Beam Span Calculator
